notes.title: 'The Ancient Remains' 1.1 Update: Repository Error
notes.content:
During the rollout of our 1.1 update for the 'The Ancient Remains', our development team came across an error within the game repository that did not allow for the full update to be merged in and uploaded. The error has been resolved, and a portion of the update has been successfully completed. The remainder of the update will be available today, 3/27, and will be uploaded shortly. We appreciate your patience and are excited for you to check out the new functionality and content.

-The Outhouse Games Team

notes.title: ‘The Ancient Remains’ Update 1.1 : Release 3/24/17
notes.content:
Coming Friday, March 24th, we will be releasing the first of many regular updates to the current version of [b]‘The Ancient Remains’[/b] available through Early Access here on Steam. Thank you to everyone who took the time to give us feedback on your experience. We have made some adjustments based on your reviews and questions and will be incorporating more of your feedback into future updates.

[b]Here is what you can expect from the 3/24/17 update:[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes and Suggested Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed shield facing the wrong direction in your right hand
[*][b]Equipping and Un-Equipping items[/b]
[list]
[*]Clicking the grip button while swinging your weapon will no longer stow your weapon
[*]Clicking the grip buttons while not swinging will still equip and un-equip as before
[/list]
[*]Quick Slots are now in their correct button order
[*]Fireballs no longer blow up when hitting the tutorial text box
[*][b]Inventory Chest tweaks to help usability[/b]
[list]
[*]Divider line to help separate right and left hand
[*]Background color lightened to increase visibility
[/list]
[/list]

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*]Playable non-generated map allowing players to explore new level area and test new room concepts
[*]New Weapons added to find and utilize
[*]Temple Guard AI improvements
[/list]
